result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile, featuring a wide roadway with no marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or continuous sidewalks. Significant visual obstructions from overgrown vegetation at the corners further compromise safety for any pedestrians in the area.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No designated or marked crossing area for pedestrians across a wide roadway.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: Lack of continuous paved walkways forces pedestrians to walk on unpaved shoulders or in the roadway.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Overgrown vegetation on the corner lot blocks visibility between motorists and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Build continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalks on both sides of the street.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge island to reduce crossing distance and exposure time.

result.summary: The image shows a high-speed multi-lane arterial road completely lacking in pedestrian infrastructure. There are no sidewalks, marked crossings, or street lighting, creating a hostile environment for anyone not in a vehicle.

hazards.name: Absence of Sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians are forced to walk on the unpaved shoulder or within the roadway, directly adjacent to high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes with multiple through-lanes encourage high vehicle speeds and increase the risk of fatal collisions.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the road requires a long unprotected crossing distance with no refuge or marked crossing points.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks separated from the roadway by a buffer to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to slow traffic and repurpose space for protected pedestrian and bicycle facilities.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised median islands to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a narrow, degraded sidewalk immediately adjacent to a wide roadway in an industrial area. While a crosswalk is present, its markings are worn, and there is a lack of physical separation or safety infrastructure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Narrow and degraded sidewalk
hazards.description: The paved walkway is extremely narrow and shows signs of significant wear and cracking, making it difficult for pedestrians to use safely.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and center foreground, along the edge of the road.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian-vehicle separation
hazards.description: There is no buffer or physical barrier between the narrow sidewalk and the active travel lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, where the pavement meets the grass.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Reconstruct the sidewalk to meet ADA standards for width and surface quality.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the existing crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Install a landscaped buffer or physical barrier between the sidewalk and the roadway to increase safety and comfort.

result.summary: The image depicts a high-speed, multi-lane arterial road with a car-centric design and minimal pedestrian infrastructure. While a bike lane and intersection signals are present, the lack of sidewalks in the immediate vicinity and the wide crossing distances create a hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic at the intersection without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no paved walkway for pedestrians on the left side of the road, forcing them onto the grass or into the bike lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Unprotected Bike Lane
hazards.description: The bike lane is only separated by paint, offering no physical protection from high-speed motor vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the travel lanes

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island at the intersection to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the left side of the road to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Add physical vertical separation (e.g., bollards or a curb) between the bike lane and the motor vehicle travel lanes.
